# Node message fixtures (NodeSource)

JSON Lines, one MQTT message per line: `{"topic", "qos", "retain", "payload"}`; a binary
payload (a raw-tap batch) carries `payload_b64` instead of `payload`. Used by the
NodeSource tests (`tests/test_node_*.py`) and by `tests/e2e_server.py --node`.

| File | Source |
|---|---|
| `td5-vectors.jsonl`, `slabs-vectors.jsonl` | Generated by the node firmware's host tests: `ostler-firmware` (github.com/openostler/ostler-firmware) `firmware/node/host/fixtures/`, commit `ceb4cc7` (2026-10-06). The node app replays the shared Discovery 2 vectors through fake ECUs and the host-test sink dumps every message it publishes (`power`, `vss/…`, `tap/…`). Copied unchanged. |
| `status-power.jsonl` | Hand-written here: the node's `status` (published by `main/net.c`, so absent from the host-test dump) and the ADR-0040 `power` states, each line tagged with a `case`. Shapes follow `ostler-firmware` `firmware/README.md` and `components/poll/src/poll.c`. |

The generated files are synthetic: fake ECUs, the identity scrub on, no VIN, `vid`
`d2-bench`. Real car captures are never committed (Constitution). Regenerate them in the
firmware repo (`cmake --build build/host --target node-fixtures`) and copy them here,
noting the commit above. Tap batches (`tap/<session>/data`) are read from phase P2 on;
the P1 tests skip them.
